heading: Tonight
text: Increasing chance of rain showers, mixing with snow overnight, then tapering off southwest to northeast. Lows from the upper 20s to mid 30s. Light west wind.

heading: Sunday
text: A mix of sun and clouds. Highs in the 40s to near 50, in the 50s in the warmer southern valleys. Light and variable wind.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Becoming cloudy. Rain spreading west to east. Lows in the 30s, 40s in the Champlain Valley. Southeast wind at 5 to 10 mph, 15 mph in the Champlain Valley with 25 to 40 mph gusts.
